messages:
Aisha: Quick PSA — please don't leave mystery Tupperware in the fridge longer than the weekend. I'm running out of detective skills. :mag:
Marco: guilty. it was mine. sorry. it was hummus from three Thursdays ago. oven justice? :sweat_smile:
Priya: take a photo and label it with `name + date` please. simple and very satisfying.
Sam: or we start a 'Thank You Jar' for people who actually throw things out. every throw = $0 imaginary credit. :coin:
Aisha: I nominate Sam for the first throw — owes us mashed-potato sacrifice. :joy:
Marco: can we do a raffle with those credits? winner gets to pick the playlist on Friday. high stakes.
Priya: poll time: React with :headphones: for indie playlist, :guitar: for 90s alt, :saxophone: for smooth jazz (for reasons).
KudosBot: :tada: Marco received a shoutout from Aisha: "Thanks for admitting the hummus crime and rescuing the open sourdough." 1 kudos awarded.
Sam: also heads-up — plant watering shift this week. @Marco you're up Wednesday. don't baptize it.
Marco: I will not overcompensate. promise. (low-key will set a reminder tho)
Aisha: tiny one-liner contest: drop the best 2-word Monday survival tip. winner gets honorary drawer-cleaner title.
Priya: "More coffee."
Sam: "Mute meetings."
Marco: "Snack stash."
Aisha: "Nap sprint."
Priya: winner by unanimous comedic silence: Sam's "Mute meetings." :clap:  (also very practical)
Aisha: ok that's it. fridge cleanup + playlist democracy + plant watch. happy almost-Friday everyone :sun_with_face:
